name: Undead Conversation
source:
After Heather is bitten, Ash locks her best friend in the basement to keep her safe, but as Heather begs to be freed, Ash must uncover what happened before she loses the person she’s trying to protect.

[From [url=https://mzgamedev.itch.io/undead-conversation]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
海瑟被咬伤后，艾什为了保护这位挚友的安全，将她反锁在了地下室里；然而面对海瑟苦苦哀求放自己出去的呼喊，艾什必须在彻底失去自己想要守护的人之前，查明当晚究竟发生了什么。

[摘自[url=https://mzgamedev.itch.io/undead-conversation]itch.io[/url]]
